fact_rationales.F10: Elevated troponin levels indicate myocardial injury, which can be seen in various cardiomyopathies and acute coronary syndromes.
fact_rationales.F18: Normal coronary arteries make acute coronary syndromes less likely, supporting the diagnosis of Takotsubo cardiomyopathy or apical ballooning syndrome.
fact_rationales.F19: Systolic apical ballooning is a characteristic feature of Takotsubo cardiomyopathy and apical ballooning syndrome.
fact_rationales.F20: The presence of an adrenal mass is more suggestive of pheochromocytoma, which can cause cardiomyopathy or crisis.
